description:
FOUND s473t6c (#1501 ROUND 10, the op/ census tail), probed vs perl 5.40.3.

`pos` is kept on a SCALAR only.  After a `//g` match on a hash element, an
array element or an `@_` alias, `pos` of that very place reads UNDEF in PCL
where perl reads the match position.

REPRODUCER (perl | PCL):
    my %h = (k => "abc");  $h{k} =~ /b/g;
    print pos($h{k}) // 'undef';            # perl 2   PCL undef
    my @a = ("abc");       $a[0] =~ /b/g;
    print pos($a[0]) // 'undef';            # perl 2   PCL undef
    sub f { $_[0] =~ /b/g; return pos($_[0]) }
    my $s = "abc";  print f($s) // 'undef'; # perl 2   PCL undef
    my $t = "abc";  $t =~ /b/g;
    print pos($t) // 'undef';               # perl 2   PCL 2   (the one that works)

WHY: perl stores the match position in the MAGIC of the SV the match ran on,
and an element or an `@_` alias IS that SV (a defelem / PVLV).  PCL matches on
a COPY of the element's value, so the position has nowhere to live.  This is
the same representation gap as NS:`@_` argument aliasing -- PARTIAL (plain `my`
lexicals only), seen from the regex side.

ROWS: it is the whole of t/op/pos.t -- 19 blessed fail rows plus the 3 the file
never produces (every row whose description says "defelem", plus "\G works with
defelem scalars", "s///g setting pos through a defelem", "pos *glob works").
The file's remaining rows are `pos` on an @array / %hash (perl rejects those at
COMPILE time -- CLAUDE.md principle 9) and the UTF8-ness row.

SIZE: not a filler.  It needs the element read that feeds a `//g` match to hand
back a PLACE whose magic can carry `pos`, which is the boxed-element question
(docs/boxed-aggregates-design-s455.md) rather than a regex one.  Do NOT try to
special-case `pos($h{k})` in the emitter: the `\G` and `s///g` rows go through
the match itself, not through `pos`.
subject: SILENT GAP: `pos` is kept on a SCALAR only -- pos($h{k}) / pos($a[0]) / pos($_[0]) read UNDEF after a //g match on that place (op/pos.t, 22 rows)
